EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.title: Define Weight Configuration Schema and Contract
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for user-adjustable weights across quality measures, including measure identifiers, weight values, defaults, and validation rules. Ensure compatibility with both provider and clinical trial scoring inputs.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.evidence: GAP: No weighting schema or persistence model exists; required to enable adjustable scoring inputs

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Logic
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.description: Extend scoring computation to apply user-defined weights to individual measures and recompute composite scores deterministically. Ensure normalization (e.g., weights sum or scaling) and safe handling of missing measures.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.evidence: ASSUMPTION: Existing scoring engines support modular measure inputs but not weighting; extension required in evaluate_care_facade.py and clinical_trials_service.py to apply weights

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.title: Expose Weight Configuration API and UI Controls
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.description: Create backend API endpoints for setting, retrieving, and resetting user weight preferences, and implement frontend controls to adjust weights and trigger score recalculation.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.evidence: GAP: No API endpoints or frontend components exist for user preference capture or persistence

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Weighting System
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.description: Develop unit tests for schema validation and scoring logic, and integration tests verifying end-to-end flow from user input through recalculated scores for both providers and clinical trials.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for weighting behavior; must extend backend test suite under backend/tests/

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.description: Integrate weight-aware scoring into evaluate_care_facade so that all outbound responses reflect user-adjusted scores, ensuring consistent behavior across provider and clinical trial evaluation flows.

EVAL-WEIGHTS.mitigation: Default weights fallback to existing scoring to prevent regression
